title: Telephone / Attention cue

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Use a small movement to draw attention because an icon can signal activity without extra text.
strategic_value: The restrained rocking telephone can carry DB icon character into a functional interface.
demonstration: A dark outline telephone rocks on a pale field and returns to a stable angle.
practical_value: Compare the moving and resting telephone states when deciding how strongly to call attention.

content_islands.name: Telephone outline
content_islands.spec: Keep the icon centered and preserve the open interior while its angle changes.

reference_purposes.Expression: The telephone outline rocks while retaining its shape and location.
